item.text: {"iteration":7,"pcvs":[{"name":"decode_work","expression":"len(self.running) + 1 if self.running else 0","rationale":"Represents decode processing with one setup unit plus one unit per running request."},{"name":"larger_admission_work","expression":"2 * (len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting)) + 1 if len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) >= 3 else 0","rationale":"Combines admission setup and per-request work, using the observed approximate two-to-one ratio between admission and decode slopes."},{"name":"singleton_admission","expression":"int(len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) == 1)","rationale":"Retains an independent feature for the exceptional singleton admission path."},{"name":"pair_admission","expression":"int(len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting) == 2)","rationale":"Retains an independent feature for the exceptional pair admission path."}],"hypothesis":"Separate singleton and pair indicators proved necessary. Including setup units within the mutually exclusive decode and larger-admission predictors tests whether phase-specific fixed work explains the remaining error without requiring a fifth feature."}
